title: Add voice search microphone icon with listening animation to search bar

requirements.text: Integrate a microphone icon as an input adornment inside the existing search bar border on the far right side of the search input field in HeaderSearchBar component

quotes: Add a Voice Search/Microphone Assistant icon inside the right side of the main search bar
Integrate the microphone icon as an 'input adornment' inside the existing search bar border

acceptanceCriteria: Microphone icon appears inside the search input border on the right side
Icon is properly aligned with the search input field
Icon does not overlap with existing search functionality

requirements.text: Style the microphone icon to match the Fourleaf pink/magenta theme (#FF2D78) with a hover state that changes color from subtle white/grey to pink

quotes: The icon should match the existing 'Fourleaf' pink/magenta theme (#FF2D78 or similar) or be a subtle white/grey that turns pink when hovered

acceptanceCriteria: Icon uses #FF2D78 or similar pink/magenta color from the theme
Idle state shows subtle white/grey color
Icon design is clean and modern, similar to YouTube's voice search

requirements.text: Implement a 'Listening...' overlay or pulsing glow animation that activates when the microphone icon is clicked to indicate voice input is active

quotes: When clicked, it should trigger a 'Listening...' overlay or pulse animation to indicate voice input is active
Ask for a pulsing glow effect around the mic when it's active so the user knows it's working

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the microphone icon triggers visual feedback
A pulsing glow effect appears around the microphone when active
Visual indication clearly shows the listening state to users
Animation is smooth and not distracting

requirements.text: Connect the microphone icon click handler to the existing useVoiceSearch hook so that voice-to-text input automatically populates the search field and executes the search

quotes: Ensure the voice-to-text input automatically populates the 'Search tracks, artists, albums...' field and executes the search

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the microphone icon activates voice recognition using the existing useVoiceSearch hook
Voice transcript automatically populates the search input field
Search executes automatically after voice input is captured
Integration works seamlessly with existing HeaderSearchBar search functionality

constraints: Do not modify the existing voice search logic in useVoiceSearch.ts
Maintain the existing Fourleaf pink/magenta theme color scheme (#FF2D78)
Keep the microphone icon inside the search input border as an input adornment
nonGoals: Changing the overall search bar layout or dimensions
Modifying existing search functionality beyond voice integration
Adding new voice recognition libraries or replacing the Web Speech API
